title: Association of Fontan Circulation With Gut Microbiome Derived Straight and Branched Short Chain Fatty Acids.
abstract: Fontan circulation is associated with progressive multisystem dysfunction, yet its biochemical mechanisms are poorly understood. Gut microbiota-derived metabolites, particularly short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) and bile acids, shape cardiovascular health. We previously reported elevated secondary bile acids in Fontan patients, but their SCFA profile remains uncharacterized.
